From Gold Experience · Pour life into objects and too much life into foes.

Theme Matter and Life

  • 1: 2 actions: stand turns an unattended object into a Tiny animal minion (1 action to command, lasts 1 minute, one at a time). When your stand critically hits, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{stupefied 1} until the end of its next turn.
  • 5: Surge, 2 actions: grow a living patch onto a wound, healing @Damage[(2+floor((@actor.level - 1)/2))d8+@actor.system.abilities.cha.mod[healing]]{2d8 + your Charisma modifier, +1d8 at every odd level} (can target you).
  • 9: Keep two animals; a creature that damages one of your animals takes half that damage back. Leap In (reaction, once per 10 minutes): when an ally adjacent to one of your animals is hit by a Strike, the animal leaps in the way: it and the ally each take half the damage (the animal's half isn't reflected).
  • 13: Your animal minions can be Small or Medium and gain your stand's Strike.
  • 17: Surge: your stand's next hit overloads the target's senses (@Check[will|against:stand]{Will}): @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{slowed 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{stupefied 2} for 1 round, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{slowed 2} on a critical failure (incapacitation).

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
